cli_help.stdout:
QRAFT � run reproducible scientific campaigns

GET STARTED
  init [PATH]       Create an editable campaign file
  check TARGET      Check whether a target is ready to run
  run TARGET        Run a checked campaign or calculation

MONITOR / CONTINUE
  status [TARGET]   Show progress and the next available action
  resume [TARGET]   Continue using saved recovery state

RESULTS
  results [TARGET]  Inventory recorded outputs and route supported exports

LEARN
  examples [TOPIC]  Show fixture-backed learning topics

Complete workflow:
  qraft init campaign.yaml
  # edit campaign.yaml
  qraft check campaign.yaml
  qraft run campaign.yaml
  qraft status
  qraft results

Setup and diagnostics:
  qraft setup --help
  qraft inspect --help

Advanced workflows and compatibility:
  qraft advanced --help
  qraft help migration

Use 'qraft COMMAND --help' for examples and options.

cli_help.stdout:
usage: hubbardflow [-h]
                   {plan,submit,reference,audit-fdf,check-projector,init,run,resume,status,report,stop,_init,_daemon-launch,_status,_stop,_report,_worker}
                   ...

HubbardFlow Linux/Slurm and PowerShell-to-WSL campaign CLI

positional arguments:
  {plan,submit,reference,audit-fdf,check-projector,init,run,resume,status,report,stop,_init,_daemon-launch,_status,_stop,_report,_worker}
    plan                freeze an FDF perturbation plan and report exact
                        qualification
    submit              consume a frozen FDF plan at the SLURM admission
                        boundary
    reference           run and archive one validated reference SIESTA state
    audit-fdf           run the existing read-only FDF consistency audit
    check-projector     compare an LR campaign projector with a DFT+U FDF
                        using explicit label mappings
    init                create a fixed-grid or policy-driven adaptive v2
                        campaign as a WSL pointer or direct Linux manifest
    run                 consume an FDF product plan, or start an existing
                        campaign worker
    resume              resume an interrupted campaign in WSL
    status              read the durable campaign status
    report              regenerate the report from the saved analysis JSON
    stop                request a safe worker stop
    _init               ==SUPPRESS==
    _daemon-launch      ==SUPPRESS==
    _status             ==SUPPRESS==
    _stop               ==SUPPRESS==
    _report             ==SUPPRESS==
    _worker             ==SUPPRESS==

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
